authorization.question:
여수에서 이번에는 차단 이유가 명확하게 나왔습니다. 기존 배포 방식에 필요한 ‘공개 GitHub 이슈 생성’이 구체적으로 승인되지 않았다는 응답입니다.

목포·여수·순천의 검수·배포 실행 요청과 IndexNow 접수 기록을 위해 joseungil-kr/fwith-site-factory에 공개 이슈를 생성해도 될까요? 사이트 주소·커밋·검수 결과만 기록하고 비밀키는 넣지 않습니다.

목포 최종 빌드·브라우저 검사는 통과했고, 실제 산출물의 독립 검수를 진행 중입니다.
scope: public QA and publication request issues and IndexNow receipt issues in the named repository; site URLs, commits and QA results only; no secrets

constraints: Preserve all frozen 75 portable files and all customer body and asset bytes
No credentials, permission/security changes or DNS ownership change
No provider overrides or existing host takeover
No create_blob, Codex/Work task or user computer
Actual successful runner, independent artifact pixels and bounded launch assessment, provider preflight, public HTTP and existing IndexNow proof receipt remain mandatory

existingIndexNowProof.interpretation: Reuse existing publicly deployed proof bytes within the authorized publication path; no new credential or separate proof-specific answer is claimed

hostScope.authorizationInterpretation: Bounded first connection is part of the requested queued public deployment in the existing workflow; no separate Yeosu-host-specific user answer is claimed. Pause if a service requires additional approval, an override, credentials, permissions or DNS ownership change.

productionSuccessor.frozen75Proof: Immutable prior complete base64 readback retained; all 75 exact Git blob SHA1 identifiers and local SHA256/byte sizes match successor tree.
